title: Money sent and money returned
hook: Two stated cases: explore the two decisions inside a trust game.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the two decisions inside a trust game affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Sender, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the two decisions inside a trust game in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy sender has 10, sends 5, which is multiplied by 3; the recipient returns fraction 0.5 of that pot. What does the sender finish with?

claims.text: Sending and returning are two decisions. A multiplier creates surplus, but the sender’s payoff also depends on the return rule. This comparison isolates the two decisions inside a trust game.
